title: Guard at Marfik Emission Nebula while a ship of ours mines gas there; docks at Node Beta
note: 2026-11-16 18:33 UTC (Apophis): the first guard route (requests.log ENT-165, orders ENT-017 block APOPHIS: fly it once with one drone). Guards mine-marfik-emission-nebula, which a ship of ours flies in runs of about 77 minutes (data/routes/runs.jsonl, four runs from 13:05 UTC). Marfik is lawless, six jumps from home; pilots of three foreign factions were met there (the tool system). The guard never fires; it leaves under 60 percent hull, in a fight, after 60 minutes or when the guarded ship is gone.
